ladders.title: module rmmod/insmod cycling WITHOUT a release
ladders.purpose: prove the probe/remove lifecycle is clean and leak-free before any boot-ladder release; the chip must stay in ROM state
ladders.classify: PASS = 3 clean cycles, no WARN/Oops, chip page+8 != 2, no release write; FAIL = any release/exception/leak

steps.action: read-only chip check (bar0read page+8 must NOT be 2) and /proc/modules must not contain hi5622_wifi
insmod the image module with explicit params (NO prepare/upload/verify/seed/release)
steps.expect: insmod rc=0, sysfs groups + wiphy present, no H2D frame posted

steps.action: record dmesg delta + meminfo, then rmmod (legal ONLY because no release was ever written this boot)
steps.expect: rmmod rc=0, no WARN/Oops in the delta
identical rc and a stable MemAvailable within the documented delta
page+8 != 2, mask 0, staging 0; never a release

ladders.title: AP stop_ap + hostapd restart in the same boot (production blocker)
ladders.purpose: decide whether a hostapd restart can work in one boot: default stop_ap_mode=0 (host-side only) then optional mode=1 (user_del teardown + re-create)
ladders.classify: PASS = second hostapd AP-ENABLED with golden page and no lane timeout; FAIL-CLEAN = cfg80211 refusal only; EXCEPTION = stop + power-cycle

steps.action: evidence bring-up to AP-ENABLED then golden readback
hostapd stop (SIGTERM) -> NL80211_CMD_STOP_AP -> driver controlled stop_ap (mode 0)
steps.expect: hostapd exits; dmesg host-side stop_ap cfg80211 state cleared, NO firmware write; page golden
AP-ENABLED again; start_ap reached + ap_ssid/ap_cfg posted/consumed; page golden; no announce timeout

steps.action: optional fresh boot + stop_ap_mode=1: stop (user_del g0 id9 committed) + restart (user_add/notify + base re-created)
steps.expect: same PASS with the controlled teardown dmesg lines
golden page/mask/staging, hostapd alive, no exception

ladders.title: AP start failure then retry (clean vs dirty)
ladders.purpose: verify a clean pre-driver failure can be retried and a dirty sequence is refused
ladders.classify: PASS = clean failure (no AP frame) then retry AP-ENABLED

steps.action: bring the stack to C2 + iface __ap (no hostapd yet)
steps.expect: C2 ok=2 timeout=0, iface type __ap, page golden

steps.action: hostapd with channel=14: rejected before the driver; record dmesg
steps.expect: hostapd fails; NO start_ap reached line; no frame posted
AP-ENABLED; start_ap reached + frames consumed; page golden

ladders.title: repeated C2 ladders across reboots (idempotency)
ladders.purpose: one cycle per run: fresh boot -> C2 -> record every gate; run 3x with a reboot between runs and compare
ladders.classify: PASS = all cycles ok=2 timeout=0, frames consumed 0 polls, mask/staging 0, identical dmesg families

steps.action: fresh golden boot + insmod + boot ladder + C2
steps.expect: h2d_status ok=2 timeout=0; rd_catalog g1 id3 deltas; page golden

steps.action: capture h2d_status, hcc_ready, rd_catalog, page/mask/staging, dmesg tail
steps.expect: all gates recorded for cross-cycle comparison

steps.action: reboot the box and repeat (operator; 3 cycles total)
steps.expect: cycle N gates identical to cycle 1

ladders.title: exception recovery check (mask != 0 -> power-cycle)
ladders.purpose: read-only detector + recovery card; no writes at all
ladders.classify: exit 0 = clean; exit 3 = EXCEPTION-DETECTED -> power-cycle per card

steps.action: classify and print the recovery card
steps.expect: on exception: STOP, power-cycle, no rmmod/retry
